title: 第783章 金蝉脱壳彻底疯狂的第二祭司第782章 绝望的蛊尊
slug: 长生家族从十七岁成为家主开始
lines: 蛊尊咬了咬牙。
“也罢！”
它尖啸一声，声音中透着一股疯狂与壮士断腕的决绝。
它那四对透明羽翼轰然燃烧。
那巴掌大小的紫金身躯，猛然爆发出耀眼的紫金色神光。
大日真火瞬息而至。
将蛊尊吞噬。
李行歌看着那在大日真火中一动不动的蛊尊，眸光微凝。
他察觉到了有点不对劲。
李行歌冷哼一声。
大袖一挥，大日真火瞬间倒卷而回。
他一步迈出，出现在那片被焚烧殆尽的虚空。
这里，现在只剩下了一层薄如蝉翼、焦黑残破的空壳。
并且，迅速化作了飞灰，飘散在星空中。
“这...金蝉脱壳？”
看着这具空壳，李行歌眼中闪过一丝恍然之色。
好个果决的畜生。
这具躯壳，可是凝聚了它几万年的修为。
竟舍得将它舍弃，只为换取一线生机。
这时，崔渊也飞了过来。
他看到李行歌脸色有些不太好看。
不由得问道：“殿下，那蛊尊...”
“逃了。”
李行歌语气淡漠，听不出喜怒。
崔渊闻言，脸色大变。
他失声道：“这......天罗地网封锁了片天地，它如何能逃得掉？”
“它舍弃了它的躯壳，施展了它的本命神通——金蝉脱壳。”
李行歌淡淡道。
这是第一次，能有生灵从天罗地网中逃走。
这太古异种，果然不同凡响，有些门道。
不知相隔多少万里的一处蛮荒深山。
这里古木参天，终年不见天日。
湛蓝的天空，突然裂开了一道裂。
一只只有手指头大小的金蝉，从虚空裂缝中跌了出来，掉在了一片腐烂的枯叶上。
正是刚刚施展金蝉脱壳神通从李行歌手中逃走的蛊尊。
只不过现在的蛊尊，气息微弱到了极点。
那原本紫金琉璃般的色泽已然彻底褪去，变成了枯黄色。
它趴在枯叶上，连振动一下翅膀的力气都没有了。
趴了许久。
“该死的人族。”
蛊尊怨恨的骂了一句。
三万年的苦修，全毁在那人族手中了。
它张开嘴。
content_en:
Gu Zun gritted his teeth.
"That's fine!"
It screamed, and the sound contained a hint of madness and the determination of a strong man to cut off his arms.
Its four pairs of transparent wings burst into flames.
The palm-sized purple-gold body suddenly burst out with dazzling purple-gold light.
The true fire of the great sun arrives in an instant.
Swallow the Gu Lord.
Li Xingge looked at the Gu Master who was motionless in the true fire of the sun, his eyes slightly condensed.
He sensed something was wrong.
Li Xingge snorted coldly.
With a wave of his sleeves, the true fire of the sun instantly rolled back.
He took one step forward and appeared in the burned-out void.
Here, only a thin, blackened and broken shell remains.
And, it quickly turned into fly ash and scattered in the starry sky.
"This... golden cicada escapes from its shell?"
Looking at this empty shell, a hint of surprise flashed in Li Xingge's eyes.
What a decisive beast.
This body has condensed tens of thousands of years of cultivation.
He was willing to give it up just for a chance of survival.
At this time, Cui Yuan also flew over.
He saw that Li Xingge's face looked a little unhappy.
I couldn't help but ask: "Your Highness, that Gu Master..."
"Escaped."
Li Xingge's tone was indifferent, and there was no hint of emotion or anger.
When Cui Yuan heard this, his expression changed drastically.
He lost his voice and said: "This... dragnet has blocked the whole world, how can it escape?"
"It abandoned its body and used its natal magical power - the golden cicada to escape from its shell."
Li Xingge said calmly.
This is the first time that a living being can escape from the dragnet.
This ancient alien species is indeed extraordinary and has some abilities.
...
I don’t know how many thousands of miles apart there is in a wild and remote mountain.
The ancient trees here are so towering that they never see the light of day all year round.
The blue sky suddenly cracked.
A golden cicada, only the size of a finger, fell out of the crack in the void and landed on a rotten leaf.
It was the Gu Master who had just used the golden cicada's magic power to escape from Li Xing's singer.
It's just that the current Gu Master's aura is extremely weak.
The original purple-gold color had completely faded and turned into a withered yellow.
It was lying on the dead leaves, and it didn't even have the strength to flap its wings.
He lay down for a long time.
"Damn humans."
Gu Zun cursed resentfully.
Thirty thousand years of hard work were all destroyed in the hands of that human race.
It opens its mouth.
